scope.local_runtime: B/L/R decisions and local file effects are exercised with deterministic fake adapters and local bare-Git fixtures.
scope.hosting: No A41-A54 hosting requirement is inferred; Doppler evidence is a real isolated provider scoped-read run, not a Git hosting run.
scope.provider: Real isolated Doppler evidence covers A41/A42/A45 and current basic A44/A46 upload/merge/readback/baseline, invalid-token denial and injected post-write acknowledgement loss; docs/doppler-basic-evidence.json.
limitations: Basic preflight is not atomic same-key CAS or cross-service fencing.
Acknowledgement loss is injected after actual provider success, not an actual outage; invalid-token denial does not prove scoped permission403.
Historical unsafe native-tool profiles remain disabled; retained failed traces are not erased.

classification_legend.proven_local: Executed local assertions cover the stated behavior in the documented local fixture scope.
classification_legend.proven_hosting: Applicable executed real external-provider or hosting evidence supplements local assertions.
classification_legend.incomplete: A required branch, capability, output path, or postcondition remains unproven.
classification_legend.unverified: No applicable executed evidence was found.
